intro.privacy: Your camera stays on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.

quests.title: Two quests, one car
quests.lead: Find the car for a chance at {gift}. Then catch it on camera for a second chance.

find.title: Find the car
find.description: Look out for the yellow Jeep with black lightning bolts, red dots and a POKEMON plate. It turns up somewhere new around the city.
find.step1: Spot the car around the city
find.step2: Join Grade10 as a member. It's free
find.step3: Top up your points on the spot
find.step4: Show our staff for your chance at the prize
find.joinText: Join now, and you're set the moment you find the car.
find.member: You're a member. Top up at the car and show our staff.

catch.step1: Catch the car with the camera on this page
catch.step2: Post your photo to Instagram or Threads
catch.step3: Send us a screenshot of your post here
